Chapter 476: Chapter 15: The Temptation of the Ninth Layer of Heaven (Please Subscribe)_2

This is also the most efficient method, first understanding these Powers of Creation and then bringing them to the Main World to transform into Cosmic Forces.

Although he had the world coordinates of the Spirit Realm, Lin Yuan could return to this world at any time, but it would cost ten strands of World-Breaking Origin Force, so he needed to be cautious.

“In fact, ordinary Powers of Creation are just a part of the higher Powers of Creation…” Lin Yuan mused thoughtfully.

Although the dozens of Powers of Creation he comprehended were all at the First Layer of Heaven, they involved four higher Powers of Creation.

Take, for example, the Immeasurable Force, a higher Power of Creation, which encompassed a variety of ordinary Powers of Creation, including Innate Purple Qi, Fluctuation Domain, and so on.

Infinite Cutting is also a higher Power of Creation… one aspect of the Open Heaven Force.

...

“Unfortunately, not all Supreme Immortal Kings possess the higher Powers of Creation. Ordinary Powers of Creation, if cultivated to the Third Realm, are also close to the Second Realm of higher Powers of Creation…”

Lin Yuan silently thought to himself, most Creation Immortal Kings who mastered several Third Realm ordinary Powers of Creation have combat powers that are not much weaker than those of Open Heaven Immortal Kings.

The main issue is that cultivating higher Powers of Creation to the Third Realm is extremely difficult, even Open Heaven Immortal Kings and Supreme Immortal Kings stop at the Second Realm.

“The dozens of Powers of Creation I’ve mastered, although they are all at the First Layer of Heaven, when combined, should they not be almost as powerful as the Third Realm of a certain higher Power of Creation?”

Lin Yuan secretly thought.

If he only pondered one or two higher Powers of Creation, with Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding, he might be able to cultivate them to the Third Realm in three hundred years.

But this did not meet Lin Yuan’s expectations; there were so many Powers of Creation in the Spirit Realm, bringing them to the Main World would transform them into Cosmic Forces, quantity is definitely more important than quality.

Quality can be improved after returning to the Main World, but as for quantity… if not satisfied, one can only pay ten strands of World-Breaking Origin Force to return to the Spirit Realm.

…

Understanding dozens of Powers of Creation was only a part of Lin Yuan’s harvest from three hundred years of cultivation.

Lin Yuan also surpassed the Third Stage in the perfection of the Eighth Stage Martial Tao and entered the Fourth Stage.

In Lin Yuan’s conception, the Eighth Layer Part is divided into four stages. Reaching the Fourth Stage means he’s nearly at the end.

This also aligns with many Evolutionary Paths in the Main World, which are also divided into four stages for their Eighth Layer Part.

As for becoming invincible beyond the Eighth Layer, in essence, it’s also in the Fourth Stage, but having mastered some kind of Cosmic Force, it’s considered an unreplicable case.

“Unfortunately, the Main World has a lot of restrictions on Cosmic Forces. My Taiji Force is a Cosmic Force; future Martial Dao Cultivators, even if they follow my footsteps step by step, will not be able to transform into this kind of Cosmic Force again…”

Lin Yuan slightly shook his head.

Of course, if the Taiji Force doesn’t work, one could try other forces,

For example, the Five Elements Force: metal, wood, water, fire, earth – these five basic elements nurture and restrain each other,

Once these five basic Rules are fully understood, and the Five Elements Rules are fused, it will probably be another Cosmic Force.

Martial Dao encompasses all Daos and theoretically, it has the potential to give birth to many Cosmic Forces.

“There’s also the Space Rules Model…”

Within the depths of Lin Yuan’s eyes, faint spatial fluctuations began to appear.

In three hundred years, Lin Yuan has fully understood up to 4,600 core spatial models; aside from the 3,000 understood three hundred years ago, he has comprehended more than 1,600 more in these three hundred years.

To know, there are over 7,000 core spatial models, and as the number increases, the difficulty of understanding them increases. Under such circumstances, Lin Yuan was still able to comprehend more than 1,600, which is quite incredible.

“4,600 core spatial models, taking the Main World’s Eighth Stage Evolvers as a template, my Inner World should have a size of about 680,000 miles in radius.”

The more spatial models one comprehends, the larger the Inner World becomes. Theoretically, if Eighth Layer Evolvers comprehend 7,782 core spatial models, their Inner World could reach a size of ten million miles in radius.

“But that’s the size of a normal Eighth Layer Evolver’s Inner World… The size of my Inner World…” A trace of peculiarity appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

With the blessing of the Mysterious Gourd, Lin Yuan’s Inner World had nearly reached a staggering seventy million miles in radius.

Such an immense Inner World, let alone human Eighth Layer Evolvers, even the Starry Sky Wanderer Kun of the peak bloodline and special beings couldn’t compare.

Theoretically, the upper limit of the Starry Sky Wanderer Kun’s Inner World is fifty million miles in radius, and that is why Starry Sky Wanderer Kun is known as a peak bloodline, with an upper limit five times that of humans.

But now, Lin Yuan’s Inner World has exceeded the upper limit of the Starry Sky Wanderer Kun’s Inner World by a large margin, which is quite unbelievable.

The most crucial thing is, an Inner World with a seventy million miles radius is still far from Lin Yuan’s limit.

“The gourd…”

The inner world’s size surpassed that of other Eighth Layer evolvers’ spatial understanding by tenfold, naturally because Lin Yuan’s absorption of the liquid inside the mysterious gourd had reached the fourth kind.

Out of the seven types of liquid—red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and purple—Lin Yuan had begun to absorb the green liquid.

The color of the mysterious gourd also transformed into a grayish-green.

“The difficulty of absorbing the green liquid is far greater than the first three types of liquids; I started absorbing this kind twenty years ago, but until now, it has not even increased my physical body’s power in the inner world by one fold…”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly, predicting that the absorption rate would only slow down as he progressed, especially with the last three types—cyan, blue, and purple. Lin Yuan even suspected they might be prepared for Eighth Layer life forms.

“No matter what, I’ve already made a killing. Having an inner world ten times larger out of nowhere, even Supreme Beings would find it inconceivable, right?”

Lin Yuan didn’t know if Supreme Beings could achieve this, but at least with his identities as a Seventh-Level Citizen coupled with being the Star Lord and the founder of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, he had never heard of such a thing.

“Now the power of my Taiji Primordial Spirit is far weaker than my True Body…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Without the mysterious gourd, there wouldn’t be much difference between the power of the Taiji Primordial Spirit and the True Body.

The True Body mastered the powers of Taiji, Open Heaven, and other Cosmic Forces, which the Taiji Primordial Spirit could also wield.

Even because of the nature of its soul energy physique, the Taiji Primordial Spirit could be a bit more troublesome.

But now,

due to the gap in the inner worlds,

the Taiji Primordial Spirit’s inner world is only 6.8 million miles in circumference.

On the other hand, the inner world created by the True Body has reached 70 million miles in circumference.

With a tenfold difference, the True Body and the Primordial Spirit are simply not on the same level.

…

The Three Thousand Dao Provinces.

Xuanwang Domain.

Martial Temple.

With three hundred years of development, today’s Martial Temple has become a massive presence in Dongyun Tao Province.

Its influence has transcended Dongyun Tao Province, spreading to dozens and even hundreds of adjacent provinces.

Across the entire Three Thousand Dao Provinces, the influence of the Martial Tao Cultivation System might not match that of the Immortal Path, but within Dongyun Tao Province and the surrounding provinces, its influence is undoubtedly unmatched.

Even the Immortal Path cannot suppress the Martial Tao in the slightest.

The reason is that the Martial Ancestor himself is personally stationed in the Martial Temple.

Over the past three hundred years, the Martial Ancestor has made several appearances to give lectures on the nature of Martial Tao, leading countless geniuses and prodigies onto the path of Martial Tao.

Inside the cave abode,

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

“Martial Tao now…” Lin Yuan slowly opened his eyes. After three hundred years of promoting Martial Tao, the current Martial Tao Cultivation System had become the strongest cultivation system beneath the Immortal Path, second to none.

Over the past three hundred years, the occasional Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King sought to visit Lin Yuan, only to sense a fraction of Lin Yuan’s strength, as had the man in the purple robe, before ordering their disciples and descendants not to oppose the Martial Temple.

Over time, the influence of Martial Tao grew larger and larger.

It is predictable that, with time passing, Martial Tao might truly reach the heights of the Immortal Path.

The only dissatisfaction for Lin Yuan was that, to this day, Martial Tao had still not produced an Eighth Stage powerhouse.

Despite several lectures, they have only resulted in a large number of Martial Tao Fifth Stage and Sixth Stage practitioners.

However, the Eighth Stage of Martial Arts, comparable to a Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King—a warrior of the Martial Path—alluding to an Eighth Stage powerhouse, has yet to emerge.
